Selected source force is SHOULD; OfficialStatement remains byte-identical to the inventory statement. All 12 populated cells of the selected class matrix have separate assertions and evaluation-based timeframes. A/B share values; C and D differ, especially D N5 IRV+LEV at 12 hours. The goal is achieved lower potential agency impact, not patch scheduling, and N1 has no numeric source deadline. Definition comparisons: Fully Mitigated Vulnerability: Likelihood OR PAIN reduced to negligible while vulnerability remains detected; it is not elimination. Likely: Reasonable contextual probability does not prescribe a percentage or scoring product. Partially Mitigated Vulnerability: Reduced likelihood OR PAIN still leaves exploitation risk and a detected vulnerability; a planned reduction is insufficient. Potential Agency Impact: Cumulative likely effects across agencies govern PAIN; a scanner severity or single-system impact is not automatically equivalent. Remediated Vulnerability: Neutralized/eliminated and no longer detected; mitigation alone cannot establish remediation. Vulnerability: Includes Practice gaps, weak credentials, exposures and process weaknesses as well as software defects; scanner-only coverage is insufficient. MUST: Absolute requirement includes security-documentation treatment; a collected artifact is not compliance. MUST NOT: Absolute prohibition includes security-documentation treatment; evidence routes cannot authorize prohibited action. SHOULD: Valid departures require full implications weighed and MUST be explained in security documentation; recommendation is not mere silence. SHOULD NOT: A justified departure requires weighing full implications and MUST be documented; it is not an absolute prohibition. MAY: Truly optional; decisions SHOULD be explained in security documentation, without making optional adoption mandatory. Internet-Reachable Vulnerability (IRV): Internet-origin payloads can reach indirectly; classification is specific to the vulnerable machine processing the payload, not the entire network. Likely Exploitable Vulnerability (LEV): Conjunctive not-fully-mitigated, likely-actor reachability and likely adverse effect tests apply; automated unauthenticated internet exploitation is at minimum LEV.
